children: China IT solutions provider's H1 revenue rose 4.08% yr/yr to RMB708.55 mln
Company posted net loss of RMB37.77 mln, compared with profit a year ago
Loss driven by higher costs, increased R&D, and absence of prior one-off gain
Company expects to complete disposal of its Beijing Jingguosheng Investment Fund equity interest in 2026
HIGHER COSTS - Co said intensifying industry competition and rising market costs increased contract fulfillment expenses
INCREASED R&D SPEND - Co said higher investment in R&D, AI, and industry-specific product development affected results
ABSENCE OF ONE-OFF GAIN - Co said prior period profit benefited from a one-time gain on subsidiary liquidation, not repeated in current period
